$comment: Native demo packages (packaging/README.md). One entry per downloadable target: how it is built and checked, and what the site tells a player. package.mjs, verify.mjs, site/scripts/demos.mjs (keys, store, releases), checks.yml (through `demos.mjs plan`) and the site's demo pages all read this file. A target is offered for download only when a release holds its package.

targets.label: Windows
targets.requirements: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, a GPU with Direct3D 11, OpenGL or Vulkan.
install: Run <Game>.exe. Windows SmartScreen may say the publisher is unknown, because the program is not signed: choose More info, then Run anyway.

targets.label: Linux
targets.requirements: A 64-bit x86 distribution with glibc 2.34 or later (for example Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 35 or newer), an X11 or Wayland desktop with OpenGL (Mesa or a GPU driver), and PulseAudio or PipeWire for sound. The alternative --platform raylib needs glibc 2.38 (Ubuntu 24.04 or newer).
install: Run ./<Game>/<Game> from a terminal or your file manager.

targets.label: macOS
targets.requirements: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon (M1 or newer). Intel Macs are not packaged.
install: Extract the ZIP and move <Title>.app wherever you like.

The app is not notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open it once, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway; or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "<Title>.app" in Terminal.

targets.label: Android
targets.requirements: Android 7.0 (API 24) or later on a 64-bit ARM or x86 device. On-screen touch controls; a keyboard or gamepad also works.
install: Download the APK on the device.
Open it. Android asks once to allow installing apps from that source (your browser or file manager); allow it, then install.
The APK is signed with MicroEngine's demo key, so later demo versions install as updates.
